protocol.description: supplemental synthetic feature-assisted WCS benchmark inspired by pasted comprehensive script
protocol.features: normalized Euclidean coordinate cost C; matched coordinates share frame
protocol.topology: distance-quantile sparse graphs with independent per-graph add/remove edge perturbations
protocol.edge_perturbation: round(0.5*sigma*undirected_edge_count) added and removed edges per graph; zero at sigma=0
protocol.objective: common discrete alpha=0.7 graph residual plus normalized coordinate cost; lower is better
protocol.timing: solver plus required baseline projection, per-instance wall clock; randomized method order
adaptations: FAQ solves padded full QAP and selects L pairs by unary coordinate cost; not an exact-L QAP optimizer.
POT partial OT and FGW return soft couplings, projected to exact-L maximum-score injective matchings.
POT/FGW optimize their native transport criteria; reported common WCS objective is an external evaluation metric.
Local 2018-style RLX1F is an in-workspace reconstruction, not original author code.

method_settings.Fast-WCS v3: alpha=.7, max_iter=8, fw=3, quartic, exact augmented oracle, local refinement
method_settings.Fast-WCS v2: alpha=.7, max_iter=8, fw=3, closed-form classic line search, dummy-padded oracle
method_settings.SciPy FAQ + unary truncation: padded full QAP then keep L lowest unary-cost pairs
method_settings.Coordinate-only Hungarian: exact-L assignment minimizing only normalized unary coordinate cost C
method_settings.POT partial OT + exact-L projection: partial Wasserstein on C, then exact-L maximum-score projection
method_settings.POT FGW + exact-L projection: FGW alpha=.5, then exact-L maximum-score projection
